raw_segments.text: Morning to ye, morning to ye," he rejoined, again moving off.
"'Oh, I was going to warn ye against.
But never mind, never mind, it's all one, all in the family, too.
Sharp frost this morning, ain't it?
Shouldn't see ye again very soon, I guess, unless it's before the grand jury.'
And with these cracked words he finally departed, leaving me, for the moment, in no small wonderment
